purpose: Hardware reference inputs for a native Rust AVR8js compatibility port; not a claim of full hardware fidelity.
vendor_document_license: Microchip/Atmel documents retain their own copyright and terms; they are not covered by this project's MIT software license.

documents.title: AVR Instruction Set Manual
documents.scope: Opcode encodings, addressing modes, SREG formulas, instruction lengths and core-specific cycle counts.
documents.note: The stable PDF URL serves revision B, not the newer online revision C (11/2024). This PDF is intentionally pinned; do not mix core timing columns.

documents.title: ATmega48A/PA/88A/PA/168A/PA/328/P megaAVR Data Sheet
documents.scope: Primary AVR8js device: CPU/data memory, interrupts, clock, EEPROM, GPIO, timers, SPI, USART, TWI, ADC, watchdog; register map and errata.

documents.title: ATtiny25/45/85 Datasheet
documents.scope: Distinct ATtiny Timer/Counter1, shared interrupt/prescaler registers, pin routing, PLL, USI and silicon errata.

documents.title: ATmega640/1280/1281/2560/2561 Datasheet
documents.scope: Large-flash PC/stack behavior, EIND/RAMPZ, extended instructions, extra timer compare channels and device-specific vectors.

unavailable_legacy_reference.note: Original URL cited in AVR8js; current official DS40002198B manual downloaded instead. No mirror substituted.
